description: This is a Java source file that implements an import handler for savings accounts in the Apache Fineract project. It reads savings account data from an Excel workbook, processes the data including creation, approval, and activation of savings accounts, and handles errors during import.

classes.name: SavingsImportHandler
classes.description: This class handles importing savings account data from Excel files into the Fineract system, including creating accounts, approving, and activating them.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point that processes a workbook to import savings accounts, approvals, and activations.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads data from the Excel workbook into lists of savings account data, approvals, activations, and statuses.

methods.name: readSavingsActivation
methods.description: Reads savings account activation date from a row.

methods.name: readSavingsApproval
methods.description: Reads savings account approval date from a row.

methods.name: readSavings
methods.description: Reads savings account data from a row and creates a SavingsAccountData object.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Handles the import of savings accounts into the system, including creating accounts, approving, and activating them, with error handling.

methods.name: writeSavingsErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error messages and status into the Excel report when an import step fails.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Sets up headers for the report columns in the Excel sheet.

methods.name: importSavingsActivation
methods.description: Imports a savings account activation command.

methods.name: importSavingsApproval
methods.description: Imports an approval command for a savings account.

methods.name: importSavings
methods.description: Creates a savings account in the system via command and returns the result.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the current progress level based on the status string.
